# `app.graycard.defs`

Fixed-point number scaled by 1,000,000. Used for values projected into a photo's EXIF record (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif), which stores numerics at this fixed scale. Prefer #measure for graycard-native quantities.

## `scaledInteger`

Fixed-point number scaled by 1,000,000. Used for values projected into a photo's EXIF record (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif), which stores numerics at this fixed scale. Prefer #measure for graycard-native quantities.

**Kind:** `integer`

**Resolved type:** `integer`

<a id="measure"></a>

## `measure`

Self-describing scaled quantity. The real value is value / scale; scale defaults to 1 when absent. unit names the physical unit (e.g. celsius, dpi, stop, ev, mm, second, ml).

**Kind:** `object`

### Resolved fields

| `scale` | no       | `integer`           | `minimum=1`    |              |             |

<a id="geolocation"></a>

## `geoLocation`

A geographic location. latitude/longitude are integer degrees scaled by 1e7 (real value = value / 1e7); altitude and accuracy are integer millimetres (real metres = value / 1000). placemark is an optional reverse-geocoded address. Storing scaled integers keeps atproto-native precision (~1cm) without a float type.

**Kind:** `object`

<a id="assetref"></a>

## `assetRef`

Reference to an asset that belongs to a catalog type: a product photo, a datasheet. Exactly one of url / file / record should be set. A url is preferred: it points at the publisher's own copy, so third-party material (manufacturer product photography, datasheet PDFs) is linked rather than redistributed. Use file only for assets you may lawfully host (your own photograph, a permissively licensed one); use record to point at another atproto record holding the asset.

**Kind:** `object`

### Resolved fields

Referenced object fields are expanded once. A linked type name opens the definition that supplies the field.

| Field      | Required | Type / resolved ref | Constraints                                                                         | Known values | Description                                                                      |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `url`      | no       | `string` (`uri`)    | `maxLength=2048`                                                                    |              | Link to the asset where its publisher hosts it (preferred).                      |
| `file`     | no       | `blob`              | `maxSize=10000000`<br />`accept=image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, application/pdf` |              | The asset itself, uploaded to this repo. Only for content you may lawfully host. |
| `record`   | no       | `string` (`at-uri`) |                                                                                     |              | Another atproto record holding the asset.                                        |
| `mimeType` | no       | `string`            | `maxLength=128`                                                                     |              | Media type, useful when a url or record does not advertise one.                  |
| `title`    | no       | `string`            | `maxLength=256`                                                                     |              | Human label, e.g. "Tri-X 400 technical data".                                    |
| `source`   | no       | `string`            | `maxLength=256`                                                                     |              | Who published the asset (e.g. "Eastman Kodak Company"), for attribution.         |
| `license`  | no       | `string`            | `maxLength=128`                                                                     |              | License or usage terms of the asset, when known.                                 |
